title: Prepare and file annual returns
summary: A company generally makes and delivers an annual return to the Corporate Affairs Commission, subject to CAMA's stated exceptions.
deadline_rule: Deliver the annual return within the period CAMA prescribes after the return date.
consequence: Persistent failure to file can attract penalties under CAMA and expose the company to being struck off the register.
requirements: Use the return form and information required for the company's type.
Have the return completed and signed as CAMA requires.
Deliver the return within the applicable deadline.
Attach the required financial statements, reports, and certificates when applicable.
